Mary, Meghan and Erica are no exception! The good news is, their favorite star is on her way to their town to play a concert! But the girls are broke! All they can do is watch her videos on YouTube! And dream that someday they'll get to see a real concert! No, girls, we can't do that! We have to follow our dreams! Can't we find the money? Let's see what we've got! No girls! We can't do that! We have to follow our dreams! Can we find the money? Let's see what we've got! Hmm, not much! Barely enough for a popsicle outside of the concert venue! We need a start-up idea! Alright, let's get rich! We already have a couple of interesting ideas. What if you tried being a psychic? Love Predictions for Cash. Isn't that a great startup idea? Magic, rituals, fortune-telling! I think we picked a great idea. Bright makeup and a beautiful crystal ball! The secret to success is teamwork! Erika talks to the visitors! And Mary shares clues into her headphone! We have to hurry! The first customer is on the doorstep! This cute girl wants to know if she has a future with this guy! Erika starts working! And the girls are doing pretty well! Erica pretends to be catching psychic waves! Let me see what your heart wants! And Mary is studying social media! Do you copy? He liked her picture! Which means there's a chance! You just have to tell the trusting client that you see a wedding and a couple of cute kids! People are so eager to believe what they want to hear! And Megan has a different approach! She decided to make money from her art! A portrait for a dollar is a very good deal! But first, you need to excite your target audience the girls developed a whole promotional campaign Erica is playing the role of a fake client who loved her portrait so much she is setting a great example for people passing by. And once the first real client comes, you can create. Hopefully the client likes the result. But Megan hasn't graduated from art school yet. So it takes too long to make a portrait. and it didn't come out nice either but she still got the money well what did you expect for a dollar the friends are celebrating their first profit only it doesn't seem like they will get many customers how's this for a start-up?! Providing a lawn care service! That doesn't seem hard at all! Mowing the grass, trimming hedges. Megan and Mary will definitely be able to handle it! But the customer may vary! Mow the lawn, but don't you dare touch the daisies! The customer is always right! Time to get to work! Looks like Mary has nothing to do here. Meghan's doing great without her! But the girls relax too early! Whoops, oh no! We destroyed the client's favorite flowers! We need to come up with something now. Right, just plant the flowers right back And then take the money from this rich man and go home! Hopefully he doesn't notice anything! The customer is happy with the lawn mowing. We'll see what he'll say when his flower bed starts to wither. No! Landscape design is clearly not their thing! You need to think big to make money! Open a tattoo parlor! That's pretty brave. But why do you need three artists? You'll see. Here comes the first client And he knows exactly what he wants. That's a great sketch, And he knows exactly what he wants! That's a great sketch! Except the friends are being a little tricky. Instead of a real tattoo, it's temporary! While Erica's dealing with the sticker, Mary's making noise with her tattoo machine. And Meghan is putting on a whole show! Magic tricks to distract the client smart to be more convincing you have to poke the client with skewers so it feels real everybody is happy both the payment for the service is non-refundable! Time to get serious! Let's open a beauty salon that specializes in removing pimples! We have what we need! Gloves, a sign! And we'll deal with our lack of knowledge as we go! Here comes the first pimple client! Oh. You must have the wrong door. Oh he has some money. That's different! Dear Guest, welcome! Just get a tool, and you are good to go! It's a hard job. But you'd do anything for a dream. Even turn someone like him into a prince! But it's not going so well. New pimples are filling his face at the speed of light! Nothing can help him anymore! Um, are you sure it's not contagious? The girls definitely don't like this start-up idea! A garage sale is what they need. Clear out your wardrobe and make some money at the same time. Every buyer is welcome here! Ewww! What's this? But I think I'll take this dress. Looks like the business is booming. These shoes will match your dress perfectly! Awesome! One more sale! Everyone will find something here! See? There is a client for every little thing! One man's trash is another man's treasure! Oh, it's that guy with pimples again there is definitely nothing for you here and this is definitely not your size well a couple of big bills will melt any heart why don't you take these glasses pink my favorite color we all had a good! And we even made some good money! Oh wha t a mess! This room needs urgent cleaning! But it's a good thing this old lady has helpers! They'll clean this place up for a modest fee. Meghan and Erica's cleaning company is on the case! And why are you giving this girl some money? I know! And what about me? I think you are having a bad time with him. And this is my job, right? And this is not so important! It's more important to your future! And this is not my job, not mine! We're not engaged, right? We're not married! And that's a real problem! And why? Because all you do is have another daughter! Then you can come to my father. You have no children! In a couple of hours, it's clean! Nice work! But grandma's not going to stop! Why is she so mean? And when it's time to pay for the job, things get even worse! Where's the trash coming from?? We just cleaned up! I don't know! I won't pay full price for such a bad job! What? A few coins for half a day's work? We are going to have to cancel this startup! But you can always work in advertising! It's an easy, outdoor job! What else could you want? But first you have to spend all day putting up your own ads for your own services! That's a weird idea! Maybe you should have searched for customers on the internet?! And Mary has her own startup looking after other people's kids for money. She got decides to become a baby sitter. There are plenty of customers. And so many children! Mary wants to start with one child, since she has no experience. But she really needs the money! Mary is super enthusiastic! Want to read a book? Nah, that's boring! These kids aren't interested in fairy tales... Give them makeup! Whoops! My favorite brushes! Come on, be careful! While Mary's crying over her brushes, her glasses and lipstick get carried away! Oh no! This is super resistant lipstick! It's a nightmare! As soon as you turn your back, they ruin something! This doesn't look like the perfect day for our nanny! Oh no! Another child! I can't wait for this day to end! The moment of truth! It's time to count up our earnings how much did we make on these crazy startups how much it's still not enough oh we also have those coins from that old lady okay now there is exactly enough for three tickets! Yay! Our dream is coming true! Get ready, Billy! We're on our way… Wohoo! We're having a blast! Wow! I almost touched the stars! The girls would come up with a hundred new startups for this moment!
